title: Calculate sinusoidal series RLC response
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for sinusoidal steady state. resistance_ohm>=0, inductance_h>=0, capacitance_f is null (no capacitor) or >0, frequency_hz>0, voltage_rms_v>=0. omega=2*pi*f; reactance X=omega*L minus 1/(omega*C) if C is present. Impedance is R+jX. Return {"impedance_ohm":[R,X],"current_rms_a":V/sqrt(R^2+X^2),"current_phase_deg":-atan2(X,R)*180/pi}. The voltage phase is zero; report the defined impedance-based current phase even when voltage is zero. Any invalid input constraint returns {"error":"invalid_component"}; otherwise if impedance magnitude is zero return {"error":"zero_impedance"}. No rounding. Component scales avoid overflow and near-zero resonant singularities. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-8, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
